title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 1
subtitle: Budget Cuts

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hum. Oh! “Important meeting. Everyone must come.” Well, back to work! And my boss has called a meeting. I wonder what it's about. Maybe we're all getting raises! Ooo, there's Jonathan! Maybe he knows.
dialogue.zh: 嗯。哦！“重要会议。所有人都必须来。”好，回去干活！老板召集开会。不知道是什么事。也许我们都要加薪！哦，乔纳森在那儿！也许他知道。

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm Professor Bot! This video is all about work. People talk about jobs and things that happen at work. Your assignment is to find as many work words as you can. Don't worry, I'll help.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我是机器人教授！这段视频都和工作有关。人们谈论工作和职场里发生的事。你的任务是尽量找出工作相关的词。别担心，我会帮你。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: So, Jonathan, what do you think today's meeting is about? The email sounded important.
dialogue.zh: 乔纳森，你觉得今天的会是关于什么的？那封邮件听起来很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Well, I have heard people in the building talking about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 我听说大楼里有人在谈预算削减。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh! Budget cuts? Wait, who has been talking about budget cuts?
dialogue.zh: 哦！预算削减？等等，谁在谈预算削减？

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: Mark in Accounting.
dialogue.zh: 会计部的马克。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Mark in Accounting? That's one person. That's not “people.”
dialogue.zh: 会计部的马克？那是一个人。那不叫“有人”。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: I know, but Mark knows everything that goes on at The Studio.
dialogue.zh: 我知道，但马克对工作室里的事了如指掌。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That is true. But wait, look at us. We shouldn't gossip. That's how rumors start. We'll just go to the meeting and see what happens.
dialogue.zh: 那倒是真的。可等等，看看我们。不该说闲话。谣言就是这样开始的。我们去开会，看看到底怎么回事。

dialogue.speaker: Jonathan
dialogue.en: You're right. No more talk about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 你说得对。别再谈预算削减了。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Budget cuts? Oh no!
dialogue.zh: 预算削减？哦不！

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I just heard Anna and Jonathan talking about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 我刚听到安娜和乔纳森在谈预算削减。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: That must be what the meeting is about. When there are budget cuts, people lose their jobs.
dialogue.zh: 会议一定就是这件事。有预算削减时，就会有人丢工作。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: Not you. You're a good reporter.
dialogue.zh: 不会是你。你是个好记者。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: And it's not you. You've done a great job as a videographer.
dialogue.zh: 也不会是你。你当摄像师做得很好。

dialogue.speaker: Amelia
dialogue.en: I can't go back to being a detective. Criminals scare me!
dialogue.zh: 我不能回去当侦探。罪犯吓到我！

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: And I can't go back to being a teacher! High school kids scare me!
dialogue.zh: 我也不能回去当老师！高中生吓到我！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Did you hear any work words? They talked about a lot of jobs. You can make the name of a job by adding an ending to a verb! Kaveh reports, so, he's a reporter. Amelia used to detect, so she was a detective. If you teach, you're a teacher.
dialogue.zh: 你听到工作词了吗？他们谈了很多职业。在动词后面加词尾就能组成职业名！卡维报道新闻，所以他是记者。阿梅莉亚以前做侦探。如果你教书，你就是教师。

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Penelope, have you heard the news? Today's meeting is about budget cuts.
dialogue.zh: 佩内洛普，你听说了吗？今天的会是关于预算削减的。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: That's awful! What should I do?
dialogue.zh: 太糟了！我该怎么办？

dialogue.speaker: Kaveh
dialogue.en: Update your résumé. I’ve already updated mine. I’ll see you at the meeting.
dialogue.zh: 更新你的简历。我已经更新过了。会上见。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Hello everyone! Quiet, please. Quiet, please!
dialogue.zh: 大家好！请安静。请安静！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: This meeting won’t take long. Then you can all leave.
dialogue.zh: 这个会不会很长。然后你们都可以走。

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: What is wrong with everyone? You look like I'm going to fire you. Ha-ha-ha-ha-ha! Seriously, what is wrong with everyone?
dialogue.zh: 大家怎么了？看起来像我要开除你们。哈哈哈！说真的，你们怎么了？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Excuse me, Ms. Weaver?
dialogue.zh: 打扰一下，韦弗女士？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Yes, Anna.
dialogue.zh: 什么事，安娜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, everyone has been worrying about, you know … We’ve been worrying that you are going to fire us!
dialogue.zh: 大家一直在担心，你知道……我们担心你要开除我们！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: I’m not going to fire any of you! No! The reason for this meeting is to tell you what a good job you’ve been doing and give out new assignments. Budget cuts have been happening. But only one person has lost their job -- Mark in Accounting? Now, let’s talk about those new assignments.
dialogue.zh: 我不会开除你们任何人！不会！开会是为了告诉你们工作做得很好，并布置新任务。预算削减确实在发生。但只有一个人丢了工作——会计部的马克？现在，我们来谈那些新任务。

quiz.prompt: What rumor do people hear about the meeting?
Who has been talking about budget cuts?
What does Ms. Weaver actually do at the meeting?
choices: She praises the team and gives new assignments
